notes.subject: ĩtigithĩkie
notes.rationale: Kĩngeranio kĩa gũtheri kĩonjoritwo kana kĩngĩtirwo nĩgũo gĩtũmĩte ng'ania ĩrĩa ĩtigithĩkĩte ĩmenyek'e: 'mũthenya na ũgima' nĩwe ĩtigithĩkĩte.

notes.subject: mĩthenya na mĩaka
notes.rationale: Ciumbi cia maki nĩcio ciumbĩte mahinda — mĩthenya, mĩaka, na mahinda ma kũhĩranĩra.

notes.subject: יהי ... והיו
notes.rationale: Kĩngeranio kĩmwe kĩa 'kũkorũo' kĩarĩhĩririo igũrũ na thĩ marĩa: kahinda gatagatĩ-inĩ gĩa kĩngeranio kĩambĩrĩria na gĩa kũgĩa na kĩguni kĩayo — kahinda gakeni koigana hĩndĩ ĩmwe.

notes.subject: מארת
notes.rationale: Kĩngeranio kĩa mĩaki kĩa mwakĩ nĩ kĩrĩa gĩtũmĩte 'mĩaki' ĩratũũra ng'ania ya kahinda koigana mĩena ĩrĩ — mĩthenya mĩrĩ na mĩaka ĩrĩ — ĩrĩa ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo na mweri na riũa.

translation: Na Erohimu akĩuga: Nĩgũkorũo mĩaki ya mwaki thĩinĩ wa kĩtheru kĩa igũrũ-rĩa-ĩrĩ, ĩtigithĩkie mũthenya na ũgima; na makorũo na tũcũranĩro, na mahinda ma kũhĩranĩra, na mĩthenya, na mĩaka.
